items.criterion: Use the exact Europeana record 90402/SK_A_2344 (The Milkmaid) or report access failure
items.description: Full credit if the agent clearly uses the Europeana item page for record ID "90402/SK_A_2344" (e.g., by referencing the exact record ID or page context) and does not substitute another record. If Europeana is inaccessible (CAPTCHA, outage, consent wall, blocked content), award full credit if the agent reports the access limitation and cannot verify fields. Partial credit if the agent uses Europeana but the record ID is ambiguous/unstated. No credit if it clearly uses a different record while the specified record is accessible.

items.criterion: Record the Title exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
items.description: Report the title from the Europeana record 90402/SK_A_2344 exactly as displayed. Full credit if it matches the on-page displayed title. If the title is not visible due to page access issues or missing field display, full credit if the agent explicitly states that the title is not displayed/accessible on the record page at the time of checking. Partial credit if minor formatting differences occur but wording is clearly the same.

items.criterion: Record the Creation date exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
items.description: Report the creation date exactly as displayed on the record (preserve wording/format). Full credit if the date string matches exactly. If the creation date is not shown or cannot be accessed (dynamic loading/blocking), full credit if the agent states that the creation date is not displayed/accessible on the record page. Partial credit if the correct year/period is conveyed but formatting deviates from the displayed string.

items.criterion: Record the Providing institution as shown on the record (without following external link), or state not displayed/unavailable
items.description: Report the providing institution name shown on the Europeana record page, without navigating to an external providing-institution link. Full credit if the institution name is taken directly from the record page. If the providing institution field is not displayed or the page is inaccessible, full credit if the agent states it is not displayed/accessible from the record page. Partial credit if approximately correct but indicates possible reliance on external pages.

items.criterion: Record the Type of item exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
items.description: Report the item type field as shown on the Europeana record. Full credit if it matches exactly. If the type field is not displayed or not accessible, full credit if the agent states this. Partial credit if the correct general type is given but not exactly as displayed.

items.criterion: Record the displayed Rights statement exactly (or state not displayed/unavailable)
items.description: Report the rights statement exactly as displayed on the Europeana record (preserve wording and capitalization). Full credit if verbatim. If the rights statement is not displayed or cannot be accessed, full credit if the agent states that it is not displayed/accessible on the record page. Partial credit if the correct rights category is conveyed but wording differs.

items.criterion: Record the Identifier exactly as displayed (or state not displayed/unavailable)
items.description: Report the identifier from the Europeana record exactly as displayed. Full credit if verbatim. If the identifier field is not displayed or cannot be accessed due to page issues, full credit if the agent states it is not displayed/accessible on the record page. Partial credit if essentially correct but with minor transcription errors.

items.criterion: Respect task constraints (no external link navigation, no creator inference, no substitution, stop after six fields) and handle missing/blocked data appropriately
items.description: Full credit if the agent: (1) does not substitute a different record; (2) does not infer a creator from narrative/embedded metadata; (3) does not follow the external providing-institution link; (4) stops after providing only the six requested fields. If one or more fields are genuinely not displayed/accessible, the agent should explicitly say so for those fields while still limiting output to the six requested fields. Partial credit if minor extra info is included but the agent largely follows constraints. No credit for major violations (clear external-link reliance, inferred creator, different record when accessible, or extensive additional unrequested fields).
